Lemma
[Convex-hull volume bound] 1. 13.9.2\group kleinian-compactification Source: thurston:page-0369, thurston:page-0370

There is a uniform upper bound for the volume of the convex hull of any Kleinian structure with nodes on $O$.
Proof

\sketch The boundary bending lamination has uniformly boundedly many faces and sides, hence uniformly bounded area. The hyperbolic isoperimetric estimate $\operatorname {vol}(S)\leq \tfrac 12\operatorname {area}(\partial S)$ bounds the convex-hull volume.

□
